title: Sandia history lists Kissinger as a seminar expert at Kirtland

tellings.quote: As part of his work, Carter organized interdisciplinary seminars featuring noted international experts and specialists, one of them, Henry Kissinger.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a redacted history of Sandia Laboratories, a US government weapons laboratory in Albuquerque, New Mexico, describes a man named Don Carter organizing seminars with noted experts around 1961. According to Michels, one of those experts was the American statesman Henry Kissinger, a detail he raises while asking whether Kissinger had a role in a secret program to recover crashed UFOs.
